basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT technician living in Vancouver, Canada. I recently got into cryptocurrency trading and have been keen on learning more about the blockchain and various exchanges. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking in the beautiful Canadian wilderness and occasionally dabble in digital art. I'm single and spend most evenings online, catching up on tech news or exploring new games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in information technology, having earned a diploma in IT from a local college. My interest in cryptocurrencies started a year ago, and since then, I've been self-teaching through online courses and Reddit discussions. Although my knowledge is still growing, I'm keen to learn from experienced traders and tech enthusiasts.
